column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline scan rules for the DAST job (.github/workflows/dast.yml).
#   action = IGNORE  — accepted / not applicable, never fails the scan
#            WARN     — reported, does not fail the scan (default for anything not listed)
#            FAIL     — reported and fails the scan
#   url-regex — leave as a single "*" to apply to every URL
# The scan is ADVISORY for now (fail-action: false in dast.yml) — this file is the
# staging ground: as each finding from the nightly report is judged, add an IGNORE
# line with a note, or fix it. Once the report is clean of un-IGNOREd findings,
# flip fail-action to true and add the "DAST baseline" check-run to the ruleset.
# (no rules yet — every finding is reported as WARN)
